topic: Is a future of only self-driving cars realistic?
scientific_conclusion: A self-driving-only road future is not currently a unitary, evidence-backed target. Bounded ADS services may be scaled conditionally when each named ODD expansion has linked assurance, degraded-mode recovery, mixed-traffic, infrastructure/connectivity, monitoring, and public-governance evidence.
human_review_required: Verify the publisher/DOI landing page and full-text relevance for every reference before scholarly submission.
Select a real ADS service and jurisdiction before applying the design protocol.
Obtain qualified safety, legal, cybersecurity, privacy, accessibility, and affected-community review before any empirical work or deployment.
